facts.fact: According to the SBE Council, 33% of small businesses used TikTok as of October 2025, up from 17% in September 2023.
facts.quote: 33% of small businesses used TikTok as of October 2025, up from 17% in September 2023

facts.fact: A 2024 Oxford Economics report, as summarized by the SBE Council, found that 88% of small businesses reported increased sales following TikTok activity.
facts.quote: 88% of small businesses reported increased sales following TikTok activity

facts.fact: Shopify reports that TikTok's median engagement rate was 1.73% in 2025 (third-party figure, not Adwave's own data).
Shopify reports that Facebook's median engagement rate was 0.046% in 2025 (third-party figure).
Shopify reports that Instagram's median engagement rate was 0.36% in 2025 (third-party figure).
Shopify reports that 51% of SMBs investing in TikTok advertising reported a positive ROI (third-party figure).
facts.quote: 51% of SMBs investing in TikTok advertising reported a positive ROI

facts.fact: Marketing Agent states that TikTok's 2026 algorithm gives 40% to 50% of its ranking weight to watch time and completion rate.
facts.quote: According to Marketing Agent, TikTok’s 2026 algorithm gives **40% to 50%** of its ranking weight to **watch time and completion rate**

facts.fact: Marketing Agent reports that videos with average watch time over 60 seconds can reach engagement rates of up to 4.90%.
facts.quote: videos with **average watch time over 60 seconds** can reach engagement rates of **up to 4.90%**

facts.fact: Marketing Agent reports that the first 3 seconds determine 71% of TikTok retention decisions.
facts.quote: the **first 3 seconds determine 71% of retention decisions**

facts.fact: The article's example test plan for a small TikTok budget is $500 total, split into phases rather than spent on one campaign.
facts.quote: If you’ve got **$500** total to work with, don’t spend it all on one campaign.

facts.fact: HeyTrendy's analysis, cited by Adwave, puts targeted TV at a $15 to $35 CPM for non-ecommerce SMBs seeking qualified local leads.
facts.quote: a targeted TV campaign with a **$15 to $35 CPM**, especially when the goal is qualified local leads

facts.fact: Adwave states that advertisers can control spend starting at $50 when launching across premium channels.
facts.quote: control spend starting at $50, and reach the local audiences that matter to your business.

facts.fact: The article suggests that a business choosing targeted TV through Adwave could put its next $500 into a channel with clearer control.
facts.quote: You want to put your next **$500** into a channel with clearer control

facts.fact: The article's suggested weekly TikTok rhythm for a real estate agent is two property-focused videos, one neighborhood or market insight, and one FAQ from a buyer conversation.
facts.value: 2 property videos, 1 neighborhood insight, 1 FAQ per week
